items.title: Jack Teagarden Interview, 1959-10-29
items.q: the only one that I remember now is Al Jordi, saxophonist, clarinet... in the band with Wingy that you worked with

ctx.x: Who was in the band with Wingy that you worked with?

Well, the only one that I remember now is Al Jordi, saxophonist, clarinet. That's the only one I remember. Uh, Steve Loicanna, I think, was playing bass. I'm sure that, uh, that's about the ones I remember now.
Oh, yeah. That was the Isle of, wait a minute, in Biloxi, the Isle of, uh, Capri was over there.
